description_en: Query the diagnostic results for a single-card diagnosis
description_zh: 查询单卡诊断的诊断结果信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-diagnose-info-for-single-card --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-smy9a5ockzp08n0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDiagnoseInfoForSingleCard

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance used for network diagnostics.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络诊断的云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance used for network diagnostics
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的云连接器实例ID
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en:
The source type for network diagnostics. Valid values:

CardIP: Use the IoT card's IP address for diagnostics.

CardID: Use the IoT card's ID for diagnostics
parameters.help_zh:
网络诊断的源类型。取值：

卡IP：表示通过物联网卡的卡IP进行网络诊断。

卡ID：表示通过物联网卡的卡ID进行网络诊断
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The IoT card's IP address or ID used as the source for network diagnostics
parameters.help_zh: 网络诊断的源端卡IP或者卡ID
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
A token that indicates whether more results are available. Valid values:

Omit this parameter for the first request or when no more results are available.

If more results are available, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

BeginTime.description_en: The start timestamp of the network diagnostics task. Unit: seconds
BeginTime.description_zh: 网络诊断的开始时间戳。单位：秒

CardIp.description_en: The IP address of the IoT card used as the source for network diagnostics
CardIp.description_zh: 网络诊断的源端卡的IP地址

Destination.description_en: The destination IP address or domain name for network diagnostics
Destination.description_zh: 网络诊断的目的IP或者域名

DestinationType.description_en:
The destination type for network diagnostics. Valid values:

IP: The destination is an IP address.

DomainName: The destination is a domain name
DestinationType.description_zh:
网路诊断的目的类型。取值：

IP：表示诊断的目的类型是IP类型。

域名：表示诊断的目的类型是域名类型

DiagnoseTime.description_en: The timestamp when the diagnostic task was created. Unit: milliseconds
DiagnoseTime.description_zh: 诊断任务入库的时间戳。单位：毫秒

EndTime.description_en: The end timestamp of the network diagnostics task. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 网络诊断的结束时间戳。单位：秒

IccId.description_en: The ID of the IoT card used as the source for network diagnostics

IoTCloudConnectorId.description_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance used for network diagnostics
IoTCloudConnectorId.description_zh: 网络诊断的云连接器实例ID

Source.description_en: The IoT card's IP address or ID used as the source for network diagnostics
Source.description_zh: 网络诊断的源端卡IP或者卡ID

SourceType.description_en:
The source type for network diagnostics. Valid values:

CardIP: Use the IoT card's IP address for diagnostics.

CardID: Use the IoT card's ID for diagnostics
SourceType.description_zh:
网络诊断的源类型。取值：

卡IP：表示通过物联网卡的卡IP进行网络诊断。

卡ID：表示通过物联网卡的卡ID进行网络诊断

Status.description_en:
The status of the diagnostic task. Valid values:

completed: The task completed successfully.

diagnosing: The task is in progress
Status.description_zh:
诊断任务的状态。取值：

completed：已完成。

diagnosing：诊断中

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the network diagnostics task

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
A token that indicates whether more results are available. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no more results are available.

If NextToken has a value, use it to start the next request
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the result list
